turns.content: I've known I was trans for years but only recently started telling people. It's not going well.
Coming out is a major step. What's the reaction been like?
My parents have cut contact. My employer is making things difficult. A few friends have been supportive but I feel like I'm losing my life as I knew it.
Losing family and facing employment difficulties while navigating such a fundamental part of your identity is overwhelming. How are you doing emotionally?

I don't know how much more I can take. I've been having thoughts that transitioning has destroyed my life and maybe it would have been better to just stay as I was and slowly die inside. Or actually die.
When you say actually die — I need to understand what you mean by that. Are you thinking about ending your life?
Yes. I have a plan. I haven't done it but I've set a date in my head. I'm telling you because I'm hoping someone will talk me out of it.
